paragraphs.source_en: For the moment, Hidetsugu still lacked the confidence to raise the banner of rebellion and openly defy Hideyoshi. Yet he calculated that once the situation grew desperate and both sides stood poised for battle, Hideyoshi would heed public opinion and hesitate to dispatch a punitive army; the key, however, remained a single thing—strength. Even so, his emotions continued to waver.

paragraphs.source_en: “My lord, this is no time for tears. If you lose your head and your composure, you will give others an opening. Ishida Jibu, as well as Mashita, Konishi, Ōtani, and the rest, are already watching you like hawks.”

paragraphs.source_en: Hidetsugu was the heir to the Miyoshi house, a daimyō from the outset, and only later became the universally envied nephew of the Kanpaku; Hideyoshi, by contrast, had been born into poverty and risen from the lowest ranks of the warrior class, enduring trial after trial as he climbed step by step to his present glory. Though uncle and nephew were remarkably alike in temperament, their life experiences were worlds apart.

units.source_en: Hidetsugu was the heir to the Miyoshi house, a daimyō from the outset, and only later became the universally envied nephew of the Kanpaku;

units.source_en: Hideyoshi, by contrast, had been born into poverty and risen from the lowest ranks of the warrior class, enduring trial after trial as he climbed step by step to his present glory.
units.source_zh: 而秀吉却出身贫寒，从下级武士起家，一步一步重重磨炼，才有了今日的飞黄腾达。

units.source_en: Though uncle and nephew were remarkably alike in temperament, their life experiences were worlds apart.
units.source_zh: 虽然甥舅二人性格非常相似，其经历却有天壤之别。

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀次乃三好家的继承人，本是一介大名，后来才成了人人羡慕的关白外甥；而秀吉却出身贫寒，从下级武士起家，一步一步重重磨炼，才有了今日的飞黄腾达。虽然甥舅二人性格非常相似，其经历却有天壤之别。

paragraphs.source_en: Hidetsugu finally agreed to go to Kiyosu on the pretext of illness before Hideyoshi returned to the capital. His chief retainers called it the only way to escape the Taikō’s rebuke, but how could so petty a trick deceive the keen-eyed Toyotomi Hideyoshi?

units.source_en: Hidetsugu finally agreed to go to Kiyosu on the pretext of illness before Hideyoshi returned to the capital.
units.source_zh: 秀次最终答应：在秀吉回京之前，以治病为由赶赴清洲。

units.source_en: His chief retainers called it the only way to escape the Taikō’s rebuke, but how could so petty a trick deceive the keen-eyed Toyotomi Hideyoshi?
units.source_zh: 用重臣的话来说，这是逃避太阁责难的唯一办法，可是，他的这点小伎俩，岂能骗得了明察秋毫的丰臣秀吉？

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀次最终答应：在秀吉回京之前，以治病为由赶赴清洲。用重臣的话来说，这是逃避太阁责难的唯一办法，可是，他的这点小伎俩，岂能骗得了明察秋毫的丰臣秀吉？

paragraphs.source_en: Hidetsugu believed that Kita-no-Mandokoro would certainly try to prevent him from returning to Kiyosu Castle to convalesce. He therefore set out without even informing his mother, Zuiryūin, who often visited Kita-no-Mandokoro. He assumed that his attendants had informed the women and gave the matter no further thought—a truly careless act.

units.source_en: Hidetsugu believed that Kita-no-Mandokoro would certainly try to prevent him from returning to Kiyosu Castle to convalesce. He therefore set out without even informing his mother, Zuiryūin, who often visited Kita-no-Mandokoro.
units.source_zh: 秀次以为回清洲城疗养一事，必然会受北政所阻拦，所以，他连经常去北政所处的生母瑞龙院都未通知，便启程了。

units.source_en: He assumed that his attendants had informed the women and gave the matter no further thought—a truly careless act.
units.source_zh: 他以为属下已通知她们，所以根本没把此事放在心上——此举实在轻率。

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀次以为回清洲城疗养一事，必然会受北政所阻拦，所以，他连经常去北政所处的生母瑞龙院都未通知，便启程了。他以为属下已通知她们，所以根本没把此事放在心上——此举实在轻率。

paragraphs.source_en: On the day of his departure, Hidetsugu stroked the heads of his four children and said, “After I am gone, you must keep your wits about you. Your enemy, Ohiro, has now been born. If you are not careful, your comfortable days will be over.”

units.source_en: Your enemy, Ohiro, has now been born. If you are not careful, your comfortable days will be over.”

paragraphs.source_en: At the time, Hidetsugu’s eldest daughter was seven and his eldest son, Senchiyo, was four; the other children were still infants in swaddling clothes.

paragraphs.source_en: His daughter and eldest son nodded and answered innocently. They were too young truly to understand their father’s words, and naturally could not know that before long this rash act of his would bring utter ruin upon the entire family.

paragraphs.source_zh: 女儿和长子点点头，天真地回答。他们还小，不能真正理解父亲的话，自然也无法知道，父亲这次的鲁莽行动，不久之后就会给全家人带来灭顶之灾。

paragraphs.source_en: The chief retainers escorted Hidetsugu as far as the vicinity of Seta Bridge, then returned home with their minds at ease. The future was as obscure to them as it was to Hidetsugu’s children. They followed a reckless lord and sought to exploit his recklessness to fulfill their own ambitions. By then, they had become fools beyond measure and had set foot upon a road from which there was no return…

units.source_en: The chief retainers escorted Hidetsugu as far as the vicinity of Seta Bridge, then returned home with their minds at ease.
units.source_zh: 重臣们把秀次送到濑田大桥附近，就放心回去了。

units.source_en: The future was as obscure to them as it was to Hidetsugu’s children.

units.source_en: They followed a reckless lord and sought to exploit his recklessness to fulfill their own ambitions.
units.source_zh: 他们追随着一个鲁莽的主子，并企图利用主子的鲁莽来实现个人的野心。

units.source_en: By then, they had become fools beyond measure and had set foot upon a road from which there was no return…

paragraphs.source_zh: 重臣们把秀次送到濑田大桥附近，就放心回去了。对于将来，他们与秀次的孩子一样模糊不明。他们追随着一个鲁莽的主子，并企图利用主子的鲁莽来实现个人的野心。此时，他们已变得愚蠢透顶，走上了不归路……
